name: Tiefling
summary: Tieflings carry an infernal bloodline: horns, tails, unusual skin and eyes, and a spark of hellish magic. Distrusted by many, they often make their own way.

age.summary: Tieflings mature at the same rate as humans but live a few years longer.

alignment.summary: Tieflings aren't born evil, but many lean toward chaos.

size.description: Tieflings are about the same size and build as humans.

speed.description: Your base walking speed is 30 feet.

languages.description: You can speak, read, and write Common and Infernal.

features.name: Darkvision
features.summary: You see in dim light within 60 feet as if it were bright light, and in darkness as if it were dim light (shades of gray only).

features.name: Hellish Resistance
features.summary: You have resistance to fire damage.

features.name: Infernal Legacy
features.summary: You know the thaumaturgy cantrip. At 3rd level you can cast hellish rebuke as a 2nd-level spell once per long rest, and at 5th level darkness once per long rest. Charisma is your spellcasting ability for them.
